title: Critique: the unfolding argument against causal structure theories

statements.text: Doerig and colleagues argue that any recurrent network can be unfolded into a feedforward network with the same input and output function, so a theory that ties consciousness to causal structure such as recurrence makes claims that behavior can never test. Safron names this as a critique of causal structure theories that IWMT must address.

sources.quote: potential means of addressing critiques of causal structure theories based on network unfolding
This is not to say that recurrence is necessarily required for the functionalities associated with consciousness (Doerig et al., 2019)
